reader_summary.overview: Many technical founders, academics, and other experts often believe that great products -- or great ideas! -- sell themselves , without any extra effort or marketing. But in reality, they often need PR ( public relations ). The irony is, most of the work involved in PR is actually invisible to the public -- when it works.
